testimonials.quote: “Learning today, building memories for a lifetime.”

The knowledge, experiences, and memories I’ve gained here will always be close to my heart. I’m grateful for this journey and excited to see where it takes me in the future.

admissionspages.eliteDesc:
The MBA program at KSBM is uniquely crafted for young professionals and recent graduates aiming for high-impact leadership careers. Through our case-study pedagogy, industry immersions, and rigorous academic standards, students gain practical business intelligence and decision-making capabilities that stand out in today's corporate landscape.

Supported by experienced faculty and corporate mentors, we focus on analytical depth, strategic vision, and holistic individual development, preparing students to excel in top multinational corporations and dynamic entrepreneurial ventures across India and globally.

faqs.question: Why is MBA at KSBM preferred by top recruiters?
faqs.answer: KSBM programs are designed with active corporate input, ensuring our curriculum remains at the cutting edge of industry demands. Through Harvard & IIM case-study pedagogy, live corporate projects, and intensive mentorship, our graduates are job-ready and equipped with practical strategic competencies from day one.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for the MBA program?
faqs.answer: Candidates must hold a recognized Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for reserved categories). Additionally, applicants must possess a valid score in CAT, CMAT, KMAT, or equivalent national/state entrance examinations.

faqs.question: How are scholarships or financial assistance awarded?
faqs.answer: KSBM offers merit-based scholarships for high scorers in entrance exams and university graduations.

faqs.question: What is the selection procedure after applying online?
faqs.answer: Once your online application is submitted and reviewed, shortlisted candidates are invited for the Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) rounds. Final selection is based on academic record, entrance test score, and GD/PI performance.

faqs.question: Is an international trip included in the MBA programme?
faqs.answer: Yes. MBA students have the opportunity to participate in an international educational trip, gaining exposure to global business practices, international markets and diverse cultures.

admissionspages.scholarshipNote: Scholarship opportunities are available for meritorious students.

hero.title: Grievance Form
hero.subtitle: Submit your concerns securely through our Grievance Portal. Whether your grievance is related to academics, administration, facilities, or campus services, your feedback is handled with confidentiality, fairness, and transparency. Our dedicated grievance cell ensures every concern is reviewed promptly to foster a safe, supportive, and student-centric learning environment.

infoSection.title: Grievance Redressal
infoSection.description: Our Grievance Redressal Cell is committed to fostering a safe, inclusive, and respectful campus environment where every student, faculty member, and staff member can voice their concerns with confidence. Through a transparent, fair, and confidential grievance resolution process, we ensure that issues related to academics, administration, campus facilities, student welfare, workplace conduct, and other institutional matters are addressed promptly and impartially. Managed by dedicated grievance committees, the system encourages open communication, accountability, and timely resolution while upholding the principles of integrity, equality, and justice. By listening to every concern and taking meaningful action, we strive to strengthen trust, enhance campus well-being, and create a supportive learning environment for the entire academic community.

legacies.heading: A Legacy of Strategic Excellence.
legacies.description:
Founded with a vision to revolutionize business leadership in the region, KSBM has consistently pushed the boundaries of traditional management education. We are not merely an institution; it is a transformative space where students are not just participants in commerce, but leaders of it.

Our curriculum is meticulously crafted to reflect the complexities of the global economy, emphasizing critical thinking, strategic foresight, and an entrepreneurial mindset. We empower our students to see beyond immediate numbers and shape the architects of commerce.

members.name: Dr. K Moidu
members.title: Leadership Vision
description: In an era defined by rapid technological shifts and global transformation, management education must remain adaptive and innovative. At KSBM, we prepare our graduates to not only respond to industry evolution but to actively drive change and foster sustainable enterprises.

Our commitment to academic excellence and industrial synergy empowers students with deep analytical rigor, strategic foresight, and hands-on leadership capabilities. We invite ambitious minds to embark on this transformative journey with us.

members.name: Dr. Navas K M
members.title: Leadership Vision
description: At KSBM, our focus is on giving students a good foundation in business and management while helping them understand the world beyond the classroom. We want them to learn, explore and make the most of the opportunities available to them.

Our BBA and MBA programmes bring together academic learning, practical exposure and interaction with the industry. We believe these experiences help students develop a better understanding of their field and prepare them for the choices they will make in their careers.

I hope every student who joins KSBM makes full use of their time here, builds good relationships and continues to learn along the way. I wish all our students the very best in their studies and future careers.

members.name: Dr Ayisha Nazreen
members.title: Leadership Vision
description: At KSBM, we believe that good management education should prepare students for the realities of the workplace. Our aim is to provide a learning environment where students can build strong fundamentals, gain practical exposure and develop the confidence to take on new opportunities.

Our BBA and MBA programmes are supported by experienced faculty, industry interactions, practical activities and opportunities beyond the regular curriculum. We encourage students to take an active role in their learning and make use of every opportunity to develop their skills and interests.

As KSBM continues to grow, we remain committed to improving the learning experience and creating more opportunities for our students. I hope every student who becomes part of KSBM makes the most of their time here and moves forward with clarity and confidence.

featuredArticle.title: KSBM Hosts Industry Connect Session on Compensation Management
featuredArticle.description:
KSBM conducted the first session of its Industry Connect Series on Compensation Management at the Seminar Hall. The session was led by Emil Mohanan, Assistant Vice President-Compensation, SMFG India Credit Co. Ltd.

The session provided students with valuable insights into compensation practices, salary structures, employee rewards and current industry trends.

sideArticles.title: CMA Annual Management Convention 2025
sideArticles.description: MBA and BBA students, along with the Director, attended the CMA Annual Management Convention 2025 on March 15. The event offered valuable insights from leading industry experts, inspiring students through engaging sessions on leadership, innovation and the future of business.

sideArticles.title: Decoding Union Budget 2026
sideArticles.description: KMCT School of Business Management conducted an insightful session on “Decoding Union Budget 2026” on 24 February 2026. The session was led by Hemakumar V, Pramitha Mary Paul, and Hafeeza K P, Assistant Professors, who provided students with a clear understanding of the key provisions, priorities and implications of the Union Budget 2026.

contentDescription: The Governing Body of KMCT School of Business Management plays a pivotal role in shaping the institution's academic and administrative framework. The body is chaired by Dr. Navas KM, with Dr. Ayisha Nazreen serving as the Special Invitee. It also includes selected faculty members who serve as academic nominees, industry representatives, and ex-officio members, ensuring a diverse and well-rounded leadership.

The Governing Body is committed to maintaining academic excellence, fostering research and innovation, and strengthening industry-academic collaborations. Through strategic decision-making and policy implementation, it ensures the holistic development of students and the institution, keeping pace with the evolving landscape of management education.
governingbodies.heroSubtext: The Governing Body provides strategic direction and guidance to KSBM, supporting the institution’s academic development, administration and long-term growth.

Bringing together students, artists, performers, and creative minds from diverse backgrounds, the festival transforms the campus into a spectacular stage filled with energy, color, and inspiration.
about.paragraph2: Immerse yourself in a world of mesmerizing dance performances, soul-stirring music, captivating theatre, expressive fine arts, photography, fashion, literature, and countless cultural experiences that celebrate the richness of artistic expression. Whether you're stepping into the spotlight as a performer, competing to showcase your skills, cheering for your peers, or simply enjoying the electrifying atmosphere, every moment at Kaleido is designed to inspire, connect, and create lasting memories.

visionContent: To be a vibrant centre of excellence that nurtures exceptional, innovative, and socially responsible leaders who create opportunities and drive sustainable growth in a dynamic global economy.
missionContent:
To provide accessible, quality management education through a practical and experiential learning ecosystem. We are committed to:  

• Empowering Individuals: Developing agile, compassionate, and confident professionals from diverse backgrounds with strong leadership, analytical,                                               and communication skills. 

 • Fostering Innovation: Cultivating an entrepreneurial spirit and a mindset of inquiry through contemporary pedagogy, industry connect, and realworld application. 

 • Ensuring Relevance: Building corporate competency via continuous industry interaction, value-added certifications, and a curriculum aligned with evolving global trends.

  • Driving Impact: Preparing thought leaders who contribute to an economically and ecologically sustainable society.

abouts.heading: Shaping Tomorrow's Business Leaders
paragraphs: At KMCT School of Business Management (KSBM) Kuttippuram, we believe management education goes beyond academic excellence—it is about developing ethical leaders, innovative thinkers, and future-ready professionals. Since its inception, KSBM has been committed to delivering quality education through its MBA and BBA programs, combining academic rigor with practical learning, industry exposure, internships, and experiential training to prepare students for today's evolving business landscape.

Our MBA program equips students with advanced managerial knowledge, strategic thinking, and leadership skills for successful corporate careers, while the BBA program builds a strong foundation in business, communication, and management for higher studies and professional growth. Supported by experienced faculty, modern infrastructure, and strong industry collaborations, KSBM provides an inspiring environment that nurtures critical thinking, entrepreneurship, innovation, and lifelong learning.

leaderships.heading: Visionary Leadership for a Better Tomorrow
leaderships.name: Dr. Navas K M
leaderships.title: Chairman
description:
When we started KMCT School of Business Management, our aim was to create a place where students could learn business and management in a practical and meaningful way. Today, with our BBA and MBA programmes, we are happy to see our students making use of the opportunities around them and growing in confidence.

We want our students to learn beyond textbooks, understand the changing world of business and develop the skills needed to build their own careers. Industry interactions, practical learning and exposure to different experiences are an important part of this journey.

I encourage our students to make the most of their time at KMCT, explore new opportunities and always be willing to learn. I wish them the very best for their studies and their future.
leader2Description:
The world of business demands a new caliber of professionals, one that navigates complexities with a balanced mindset and strong ethical compass. It is through comprehensive education and strategic insight that these future leaders are shaped, making KSBM a catalyst in creating capable minds.

We continually strive to cultivate an environment where rigorous academics meet real-world strategy, ensuring our graduates are not just business operators, but management leaders. Our curriculum reflects KSBM's dedication to robust, responsible, and forward-looking education.

KSBM focuses on instilling a culture of continuous learning and critical thinking. By nurturing entrepreneurship and values-driven leadership, we ensure that every individual leaving our doors is equipped not just to succeed, but to make a lasting impact. We empower our students to shape successful careers and turn ambitious goals into reality.
